stories.title: Follow live: Michael Harris II opens scoring with three-run HR for Braves in decisive Game 3
'I'm a Cowboy': Porter hopes to make debut for Dallas on Sunday
stories.summary: Joey Porter Jr. says he hopes to make his debut for the Cowboys on Sunday, when they play the Texans.

stories.title: Saints put RB Etienne on IR, sidelining him for at least 4 games
stories.summary: The Saints put running back Travis Etienne on injured reserve, which will sideline him for at least the next four games.

stories.title: Nurse envisions LeBron setting the table for Sixers' offense
stories.summary: Sixers coach Nick Nurse envisions LeBron James setting the table for the offense this season. "I consider him a great offense creator," Nurse said.

stories.title: Victorious Portugal united behind coach Jesus after Ronaldo exit
stories.summary: Portugal coach Jorge Jesus said his squad is united behind him as it shrugged off Cristiano Ronaldo's shocking exit from the camp to beat Denmark 4-2 on Thursday.
